data: What is the approximate maximum success rate achieved by the blue line?

The blue line represents the success rate for goals that were imagined. The caption states that the Low Coverage variant of the goal imagination mechanism achieves a 45% precision and covers 43.7% of the test set. The blue line appears to reach its highest point near 0.65 on the y-axis, which corresponds to approximately 65%. Therefore, the approximate maximum success rate achieved by the blue line is 0.65 or 65%.
